profile.headline: Software Developer at Blackstone
profile.summary:
I am a current undergraduate student at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, pursuing a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science and Engineering. I am passionate about this field of technology because I feel as though it has the power to shape the world into a much better place, but also the potential to do the opposite. My hope is to contribute to the former through the field of cyber security.

I first developed an interest in the field of computer science in high school, and as I have grown, I have realized that it is the way I would like to leave my mark on the world. Through my hard work, ability to learn from mistakes, and willingness to try new things, I believe I can accomplish this goal.

positions.title: Learning Assistant
positions.description:
Aid students in resolving any coding issues in their weekly problem sets.
Collaborate with other Learning Assistants to create answer keys to problem sets.

positions.title: InfoLab Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
Updated START, a web-based question answering system, as a full-time summer intern.
Continued working with the InfoLab as a part-time intern during the academic semester.

honors.title: Interphase EDGE
honors.description: The MIT Interphase EDGE program is a selective two-year scholar enrichment program in which accepted students attend a seven-week summer session, as well as programming during the academic year to help ease the transition to MIT and to build community among new students.
honors.issuer: Issued by Massachusetts Institute of Technology Office of Minority Education · Jun 2016

honors.title: Salutatorian
honors.issuer: Issued by Verona High School · Jun 2016

volunteerExperiences.description: Assisted patients with activities of daily living and provided aid to nurses.

organizations.name: Tech Catholic Community Council
organizations.description: The Tech Catholic Community at MIT is an international community of Christians in the Roman Catholic tradition. Our central mission is to minister to the university community. In this context, the TCC community draws people seeking truth and healing from all over the country, and the world. As Treasurer, I handle the chapel's finances.

organizations.name: Mujeres Latinas
organizations.description: The mission of Mujeres Latinas has three pillars: service, knowledge, and identity. We seek social and professional advancement and cultural enrichment of Latinas in the MIT community and the Boston-Cambridge area, promote the success of individual Latinas by providing Latinas with support and guidance in their endeavors, and raise awareness among the MIT community about the issues affecting Latinas, including but not limited to racism and sexism.
